Class SchedulingService

java.lang.Object
com.appointments.service.SchedulingService
public class SchedulingService extends Object
Service class that handles scheduling operations including viewing available slots, booking, modifying, and cancelling appointments. This service uses an in-memory repository and a notification service.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Eman

    • bookAppointment

      public void bookAppointment(User user, TimeSlot timeSlot, AppointmentType type, List<BookingRuleStrategy> rules)
      Books an appointment for a user after validating all booking rules.
      Parameters:
      user - the user booking the appointment
      timeSlot - the desired time slot
      type - the type of appointment
      rules - list of booking rules to validate against
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any rule fails or the slot is not available

    • modifyAppointment

      public void modifyAppointment(String appId, TimeSlot newSlot)
      Modifies an existing appointment to a new time slot. Only future appointments can be modified.
      Parameters:
      appId - the ID of the appointment to modify
      newSlot - the new time slot for the appointment

    • cancelAppointment

      public void cancelAppointment(String appId)
      Cancels an existing appointment. Only future appointments can be cancelled.
      Parameters:
      appId - the ID of the appointment to cancel
